The texture of the meat is slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth in areas, lacking the fine fibrous detail of real muscle tissue, though not catastrophic.
The straight lines of the blade show very slight curvature/warping near the center, which may indicate minor geometric instability common in AI generations.
